body.x: Mirae Robot (CEO Jongwoo Jeon) participated in the 2024 Future Innovation Tech Expo (FIX 2024), held at EXCO from October 23 (Wednesday) to October 26 (Saturday).

Mirae Robot specializes in robotics, coding, and AI educational equipment, including actuators and manipulators. The company also conducts teacher training, experiential events, and competitions. It operates specialized education centers, branded as “Code Studio,” nationwide.

These centers focus on creative education in robotics, coding, invention, AI, and VR, providing accessible and engaging learning experiences for young aspiring scientists. Through a well-structured and innovative curriculum, Mirae Robot nurtures talent and cultivates future scientists.

At FIX 2024, Mirae Robot showcased various robots and physical tools available in the domestic market. The company also introduced a range of educational content utilizing physical tools and launched a new brand specializing in physical coding tools developed by educators.

The educational robots on display included the Ollo A Series, Connect Series, Bioloid, and Engineer Kit. Physical tools for coding education featured Coding Car, AI Soap Car, Pio Robot, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, Micro:bit, Hamster S, and Python.

body.x: The exhibition also featured AI-enabled collaborative robots, such as the HUENIT Robot, the FAIRINO collaborative robot, the Unitree quadruped robot, the guidance robot Amy, and the humanoid robot Kkottdu.

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
